notes: Added Outfit Collection Synthesis preflight recovery before fresh scans and reviewed-plan execution.
Fixed Synthesis Result and loaded-item recovery when another Inventory bag has free space.
Improved safety for stale, partial, manual, and interrupted Synthesis states without automatically pressing Create.
Retains the browser/session, live game-tab, activity-start, and catalyst-shortage recovery fixes from beta.6.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Outfit Collection reporting that a Synthesis Result could not be returned when the active Inventory bag was full but another bag still had an empty slot.
Fixed Inventory-tab changes clearing a selected Synthesis item during result recovery by selecting the destination bag before moving the item.
Fixed stale Synthesis contents being left unchecked when starting a fresh Collection scan or executing a reviewed plan.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Outfit Collection now performs a Synthesis preflight before Check My Collection / Refresh Game State and before Start or Continue execution.
Preflight safely recovers items from Result, Catalyst 2, Catalyst 1, and Main Item back to verified free Inventory slots across bags I-X.
Handles leftover +0, +1, +2, +3 or higher outfits, Low Purify Stones, non-outfit items, and partial catalyst setups without automatically triggering synthesis.
If Synthesis state cannot be cleared safely or all Inventory bags are full, automation pauses instead of consuming or moving an uncertain item.
Existing beta.6 browser reuse, live game-tab selection, Las Noches/Sichibukai initial-state handling, and catalyst-shortage skip recovery are preserved.
